messages:
emma_sales: Heads up — ACME Health POC needs private connectivity for PHI. They can't allow internet egress from model traffic. Can we propose a PrivateLink setup for the POC?

michael_se: Yes, PrivateLink (interface endpoint) is our recommended pattern for POC because it avoids route table changes in their VPC. We can front with an NLB in our account and give them the interface endpoint service name.

emma_sales: Customer wants minimal ops on their side. What's the minimum they need to create on AWS?

michael_se: Minimal: 1) A subnet in each AZ with free IPs for the interface endpoints, 2) security group allowing TLS from their app hosts to the endpoint, 3) private hosted zone or enable DNS for the endpoint. No peering or route table modifications required beyond endpoint creation.

anja_netops: Also call out NACLs — if they have restrictive NACLs, endpoints are still ENIs in their subnet, so NACLs must allow ephemeral ephemeral ephemeral TCP 443.

jia_support: For the POC, we can offer a temporary Dedicated pool option if they need guaranteed throughput. Question: do they want request-level logging? That impacts whether logs leave their VPC.

emma_sales: They prefer logs to stay in their control. Is customer-managed KMS possible for logs/keys?

michael_se: Yes, for Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS. For Hosted + PrivateLink, logs from our side are not automatically pushed to their KMS. We can route model payloads through the PrivateLink and push access logs to an S3 bucket they own via a cross-account role if that's required for the contract.

emma_sales: Ok. Can someone paste a short endpoint creation example I can give to their infra team? Keep it simple.

michael_se: Paste this AWS CLI snippet (edge-case trimmed):

```bash
# create interface endpoint in customer's account (example)
aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id vpc-0abcd1234 --vpc-endpoint-type Interface --service-name com.amazonaws.vpce.us-west-2.vpce-svc-0abc12345 --subnet-ids subnet-0123 subnet-0456 --security-group-ids sg-0a1b2c3d --private-dns-enabled 
```

michael_se: And their DNS: the interface endpoint will resolve the service name to the endpoint IPs in the VPC. If they use custom DNS resolvers, they must forward/allow the Private DNS records.

anja_netops: FYI: If they insist on VPC Peering instead, mention this: peering requires route updates, and we cannot accept transitive routing. Peering also complicates IP overlap checks. PrivateLink avoids those issues.

jia_support: Security questionnaire snippet we can provide for SOC/InfoSec: "Redwood Inference supports AWS PrivateLink interface endpoints for private connectivity. For POC we can provide an NLB service endpoint in our account; the customer creates interface endpoints in their VPC. Network traffic terminates on endpoint ENIs in the customer's subnets and uses TLS 1.2+ in transit. Logs and keys can be configured to remain in customer-owned S3/KMS with cross-account roles."

emma_sales: Perfect. Customer also asked about NAT/egress from model instances — will any traffic egress the customer's VPC to the public internet?

michael_se: No outbound to public internet for model payloads if using PrivateLink. Our backend might still reach external update feeds for model telemetry in hosted mode — we can disable telemetry for the POC or route telemetry through the customer's ops channel on a case-by-case basis.

emma_sales: Any blockers for onboarding this week?

anja_netops: Need their infra to: create the endpoint, open SG port 443 to the app subnets, and confirm subnets have IP capacity. Also ask for a contact who can approve quick VPC endpoint quota bump if needed.

jia_support: I'll prepare a short checklist + the SQ response as a single doc we can attach to the SOW.

emma_sales: Awesome. @michael_se can you add the NLB service name and estimated IPs per AZ? They asked for IP planning.

michael_se: Rough estimate: 3 ENIs per AZ for HA, so plan ~3 IPs/AZ. I'll DM the exact service name and the pre-provisioned NLB ARN in a follow-up.

deploy-bot: scheduled reminder set for <2026-04-02 15:00 UTC> to follow up on ACME infra contact. :white_check_mark:

emma_sales: Thanks team. I'll send this to ACME now and ask for the infra contact + a preferred time for the POC kickoff. :rocket:
